core_struggle: A student who cannot stop scrolling and feels he is not doing anything with his life while watching others on trips and with internships.
mirror: You open the app and see what everyone else is doing, and the hours pass without your mind settling.

queries.hook: The mind will not settle while the screen keeps showing you a life that looks fuller, and the restless feeling of being behind.
queries.diagnose: Comparison and envy burn at another's success; measuring your life against theirs steals the contentment that was already yours.
queries.steady: What is yours to build cannot be measured against what another has; your own path walked imperfectly is enough.
queries.act: Let the scroll go, and do one thing that belongs to your own work, one small step, and see where it leads.
queries.story: A young seeker who watched others and fell behind, then found his own step and began again.

weeks: What you see is not yours
bridge: What you are living with is what the texts call measuring yourself against others, and that is where this week begins.
week_thesis: From measuring your life against theirs to doing one small thing that is yours, so the mind can settle.

week_beats.hook: You recognise the restless measuring and the feeling of being behind, named plainly.
week_beats.diagnose: You see that the scroll is not the problem, the measuring is.
week_beats.steady: You hold that your own path, walked imperfectly, is enough.
week_beats.act: You try closing the app and doing one small thing that belongs to your own work.
week_beats.story: A young seeker who watched others and fell behind shows you what one small step looks like.

insight: The scroll shows you what others have, and your mind measures your life against theirs and finds it empty.
life_context: A student under twenty-five whose phone has become a window onto other lives; the scroll goes on for hours, and when it ends the mind is still racing, still behind.
details: scrolls social media for three hours
sees others on trips and with internships
